Tomorrow will be unseasonably cool thanks to the flow off the chilly Atlantic. As we close out the week, warmth returns. For Easter weekend, while temps will be running above average, you may want to keep an umbrella nearby (it’s not a washout but not entirely dry either). The start of next week features dry weather with temperatures closer to normal.
